annotations.title: Which cruise line is cheapest for this trip

description: Side-by-side cruise lines for the same kind of cruise (a region, departure port or port visited, plus dates): each line's number of sailings, ships, median and lowest price per person per night in one cabin grade, and its cheapest sailing with book_url. Answers "Alaska in July: Princess or NCL?".

cabin.description: Cabin grade to price. Omit to quote balcony where sold, else the next grade.

calls_at.description: A port the ship must visit, e.g. "Juneau", "Santorini", "Cozumel"

from_port.description: Departure port, e.g. "Seattle" or "Barcelona"; several comma-separated: "Miami,Fort Lauderdale"

region.description: Where the cruise goes: caribbean, bahamas, alaska, mexico, mediterranean, northern-europe, european-rivers, asia, repositioning, hawaii, bermuda, panama-canal, south-america, antarctica, australia, ... (every region with sailings on sale)

ship.description: Ship name or part of it
